name: OMNIconnect
summary: Wireless Internet service provider (OMNIconnect Pty Ltd, ACN 079 282 376, ABN 36 079 282 376); omni.net.au (1999-2004): wireless broadband 256Kbps-2Mbps, OMNInet MAN, wholesale to carriers. Still trading as OMNIconnect Broadband Internet and Data Centre — business broadband, private WAN, colocation (Carrum Downs VIC).

events.details: OMNIconnect Pty Ltd, ACN 079 282 376 (reg ~1997). 1997 allocation: OMNI 'ISP Core Network' (203.143.64.0/19). omni.net.au captured 25 Jan 1999: wireless telecommunications carrier (ACA list), OMNInet MAN metropolitan wireless networking (256K Melbourne CBD), 10Mb LAN microwave, wireless bridges; Mount Eliza VIC. By 2002 'Omniconnect Internet' offered wireless broadband 256Kbps-2Mbps and wholesale carrier/ISP services up to 155Mbps.

events.details: Still trading: omniconnect.com.au sells business broadband, private WAN and OCDC colocation (site footer: ACN 079 282 376, Carrum Downs VIC); pivoted from 1999-2002 wireless retail to B2B/data-centre. omni.net.au now redirects to omniconnect.com.au.
